description: Send a 6-digit verification code to an email address, for watch access. This sends an email (the only side effect) but creates nothing. Call it BEFORE list_watches, unwatch_mark, or attaching an email to a watch with watch_mark. The code expires in 10 minutes (5 tries); verifying it returns a 60-minute session token you can reuse for the other watch tools. A code is sent even if the email has no watches, so the response never reveals whether an address has watches.

email.description: Email address to send the code to

name: request_watch_code
